lines: It's the first morning of the summer holidays.
Since MegaMart opened across the street, fewer and fewer people visit your family's little corner shop.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Morning, sweetheart. Try not to worry Dad today. The shop rent is due on Day 7 and things are... tight.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Psst! Grandpa has an old pushcart in the garage. We could sell stuff in the park and help!

lines: Grandpa is in the front yard. Walk with WASD or the arrow keys, and press E to talk.

events.speaker: grandpa

effects.log: Grandpa gave you his old pushcart.
effects.memory: Grandpa gave us his old pushcart.

lines: Ah, my old pushcart! I sold snacks from it before your dad was born.
It's yours now. But remember the first rule of business:
Buy for less, sell for more - and always be fair to your customers.
Lin's Wholesale, down the road on the left, sells stock cheap. Then set up the cart in the park.

choices.label: Thanks, Grandpa! I'll take good care of it.
Do you really think we can save the shop?

events.speaker: grandpa
lines: One coin at a time. Big things are built from small, steady steps.
And from people who don't give up.

events.speaker: grandpa

effects.log: Grandpa warned you about Smiley Steve's trick.
effects.memory: Asked Grandpa before trusting a stranger's deal.

lines: Half price, cash only, no receipts, and it ends TODAY? Oh, I know that trick.
When I was young, a man sold me 'cheap' flour. Half of it was full of bugs! I lost a whole week's money.
If a deal is too good to be true, it usually is. Always check what you're buying.

lines.text: When you look back towards the park, Smiley Steve's van has already gone.

events.speaker: mrs_lin
lines: Welcome to Lin's Wholesale! Shops buy from me in bulk, then sell to their own customers.
What you pay me is your COST PRICE. What you charge your customers is your SELLING PRICE.
The difference is your PROFIT - if you get it right!

events.speaker: mrs_lin
lines: Back again? Let's see what you need today.

events.speaker: dad
lines: Hey, kiddo. Quiet day at the shop again.
We need 50 more coins for the rent by Day 7. Don't worry - that's my job, not yours.

events.speaker: dad
lines: You've saved 50 coins? From the pushcart? I... I don't know what to say.

choices.label: Here, Dad. It's for the rent.

effects.log: You gave Dad 50 coins for the rent.

choices.label: Can I use it to buy more stock first?
Not yet.

events.speaker: dad
lines: You know what? This is the most valuable rent I've ever paid.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I helped too!

lines: You both did. I'm so proud of you.

events.speaker: dad
lines: Smart thinking. Money that buys stock can make more money. Just make sure the rent is ready by Day 7.

events.speaker: dad
lines: Rent's paid thanks to you two. Now let's work out how to win our customers back from MegaMart.

events.speaker: mom
lines: A tip from your mom: before you buy anything, ask yourself - is it a NEED or a WANT?
Rent and food are needs. Sweets and toys are wants. Needs come first!

events.speaker: mom
lines: Home already? It's still light out.

choices.label: Yes, I'll call it a day.
Not yet!

lines: Inside the corner shop, the shelves are full but there are no customers.
You can hear MegaMart's cheerful music from across the street.
MegaMart is huge, bright and busy. A sign says: BISCUITS - 5 COINS A PACKET.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Five coins? That's more than Mrs. Lin charges US. How do they make people pay that?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Maybe because it's easy. Everything is in one place.

lines: At dinner, you notice the cart money box is lighter than it should be.
Maya admits she took 5 coins from the cart money to buy sweets for her friends.

choices.label: Shout at her: "That was OUR money!"
Ask her why she did it.
Tell Mom.

events.speaker: maya

effects.log: You shouted at Maya.

lines: I'm sorry! I SAID I'm sorry!

lines.text: Maya runs to her room. The house feels very quiet.

events.speaker: mom

effects.log: You told Mom about Maya.

lines: Maya, we'll talk about this after dinner.

lines.text: Mom handles it. But Maya won't look at you for the rest of the evening.

events.speaker: maya
lines: ...Morning.

lines.text: Maya still seems upset about last night. Maybe talk to her?

events.speaker: maya
lines: What do you want?

choices.label: I'm sorry about last night. Can you tell me why you took the coins?
Nothing. Never mind.

events.speaker: maya
lines: Earlier that day, at the park...
The big kids laughed at Maya: "Your family's shop is going broke! You can't even afford sweets!"
Maya's face felt hot. She just wanted them to stop laughing.
So she took 5 coins from the money box and bought sweets for everyone.
It worked - for about a minute. Then she felt sick inside. She knew it was wrong.
All through dinner she was scared you would never trust her again.

events.speaker: maya
lines: ...The big kids said we were poor. I just wanted them to stop.

choices.label: Hug her. "We'll earn it back together. And those kids are wrong."

effects.log: You listened to Maya's side of the story.
effects.memory: Listened to Maya's side of the story.

choices.label: "Okay. But you pay it back from your share."

effects.log: Maya agreed to pay back the 5 coins.

events.speaker: maya
lines: You're the best big sibling ever. I'll work extra hard at the cart tomorrow!

events.speaker: maya
lines: That's fair. I'll pay it back. Every coin.

events.speaker: mom
lines: Maya says you sold things at the park today!

lines.speaker: dad
lines.text: Our little business owners! How did it feel to earn your own money?

choices.label: Amazing! I want to earn more!
Harder than I thought.

events.speaker: dad
lines: That's business. Every coin you earn is somebody choosing to trust you.

events.speaker: maya
lines: Leo's really funny! He did a voice like Grandpa!

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Did he now?
Everyone laughs. It's good to have a new friend.

events.speaker: dad
lines: What a hot one today! I bet lemonade was popular.

events.speaker: mom
lines: How was your day? Get a good night's sleep - tomorrow is a new chance.
It's rent day.

lines.speaker: dad
lines.text: The rent is paid - and the landlord even asked about our famous pushcart!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: This family can do anything when we work together.

lines: You finished your first week. (This is the end of the Phase 1 demo - keep playing as long as you like!)
It's rent day.

lines.speaker: dad
lines.text: We're a bit short this week. I talked to the landlord - we have a few more days.

lines.speaker: dad
lines.text: Don't feel bad. Every business has hard weeks. What matters is we learn and keep going.

lines: (This is the end of the Phase 1 demo. You can still save 50 coins and give them to Dad.)

events.speaker: mom
lines: Good morning! Lemonade sells best on hot days. Check the weather each morning before you buy stock.

events.speaker: maya
lines: Phew, it's SO hot today! Everyone at the park is going to be thirsty!

events.speaker: maya
lines: I saw a man with a big smile near the park. He said he has "amazing deals"!

events.speaker: stranger
lines: Hey there, young business person! Name's Steve. Smiley Steve!
I've got biscuits - 20 packets for just 20 coins! That's half what Mrs. Lin charges!
Cash only, no receipts, and the offer ends TODAY. Deal?

choices.label: Deal! 20 packets for 20 coins.

effects.log: You bought 20 cheap biscuits from Smiley Steve.

choices.label: Can I see the expiry date first?

effects.log: You spotted Smiley Steve's trick.
effects.memory: Spotted a scam all by myself.

choices.label: I'll ask my grandpa first.
No, thanks.

events.speaker: stranger
lines: Pleasure doing business! Don't look too closely at the dates, ha ha!

lines.text: His van drives away rather quickly.

events.speaker: stranger
lines: The... expiry date? Oh, would you look at the time! Gotta go!

lines.text: The packets were two months out of date. Smiley Steve drives off in a hurry.

events.speaker: stranger
lines: Grandpa? Suit yourself, kid - but a deal like this won't last!

events.speaker: stranger
lines: Your loss, kid!

effects.log: Smiley Steve's biscuits were stale and had to be thrown away.
effects.memory: Learned the hard way: too good to be true usually is.

lines: You open one of Smiley Steve's biscuit packets. They're stale!
The date on the packet says they expired two months ago. You have to throw them all away.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: If a deal sounds too good to be true, it usually is. Next time, check before you buy.
A boy sits alone on the bench, kicking at the gravel.

events.speaker: leo
lines: Oh. It's you again.

events.speaker: leo
lines: I'd rather be on my own today. Maybe tomorrow.

events.speaker: leo

effects.log: Leo joined your team!

lines: You really mean it? I could paint you a sign for the cart! I'm good at drawing.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Yay! A new friend!
Leo joined your team! His bright sign will bring more customers to the cart.

events.speaker: leo
lines: Thanks... but I just want to be alone right now.

lines.text: Maybe try again tomorrow. Listening first might help.

events.speaker: priya
lines: Hey! I heard you've got a pushcart now. That's so cool!
If you ever need someone to taste-test your lemonade... I volunteer!

events.speaker: priya
lines: Everyone's going to the arcade this afternoon! You HAVE to come!

choices.label: Let's go! (2 hours, 4 coins)

effects.log: You spent the afternoon at the arcade with Priya.

choices.label: Sorry, I'm working the cart today.
Come and help at the cart instead - it'll be fun!

lines: You win a plastic dinosaur and laugh until your stomach hurts. Fun matters too - but the cart stayed closed.

events.speaker: priya
lines: Wow, you're really serious about this! Okay, boss. Next time, though!

events.speaker: priya
lines: Okay, okay - but I get free lemonade!

lines.text: Priya spends the afternoon shouting "LEMONADE!" at everyone. People love it.

events.speaker: priya
lines: Hey... can I ask you something?
I'm really good at talking to people. What if I joined your team?

choices.label: Welcome to the team, Priya!

effects.log: Priya joined your team!

choices.label: Maybe later.

events.speaker: priya
lines: So... is there room on the team for me yet?

choices.label: Yes! Join us, Priya.

effects.log: Priya joined your team!

choices.label: Not yet.

events.speaker: priya
lines: Yes! You won't regret it. Nobody can walk past my smile without buying something.

lines.text: Priya joined your team! Her cheerful voice brings more customers.

events.speaker: mom

effects.log: Mom shared her secret cookie recipe.

lines: I hear the pushcart is going well. Want to know a family secret?
My cookie recipe! The flour, butter and sugar for a batch cost about 2 coins.
But people happily pay 5 coins for good homemade cookies. Your time and skill ADD VALUE.

lines.text: You can now buy cookie ingredients at Lin's Wholesale. Mom's Cookies stay fresh for 2 days.

lines: The signpost says: MARKET SQUARE ->  (keep walking east along the road)

events.speaker: grandpa
lines: Did you know there's a market square at the end of our road? Just walk east along the street.
Every year on Day 14 they hold the Summer Festival. Half the town goes!
A stall at the festival... now THAT would help the family.
The market square is busy with stalls, music and the smell of fresh bread.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Look at all the people! There must be ten times more customers here than in the park.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: That man by the purple building looks like he's in charge.

lines: The Market Office is full of papers, maps of the stalls, and a very old cat. Mr. Okafor is outside.
A sign on the empty stall says: STALL FOR RENT - ask Mr. Okafor at the Market Office.

events.speaker: okafor
lines: Welcome to the market square! I'm Mr. Okafor. I look after the stalls here.
A stall for the season costs 60 coins. And each day you open, there's a 5 coin fee for cleaning and lights.
Many more people walk through here than through the park. But it isn't cheap!

events.speaker: okafor
lines: So, would you like to rent a stall?

choices.label: Could we talk about the price?
Rent the stall (60 coins)

effects.log: You rented a market stall for 60 coins.

choices.label: Rent the stall (45 coins)

effects.log: You rented a market stall for 45 coins.

choices.label: I'll come back when I've saved enough.

events.speaker: okafor
lines: Wonderful! Yours is the empty stall at the bottom of the square. Good luck!

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: A REAL stall! Wait until Dad sees this!
Busy market shoppers want lunch: you can now buy sandwich supplies at Lin's Wholesale.

events.speaker: okafor

effects.memory: Talked Mr. Okafor into a fair discount.

lines: You know what? I like you. 45 coins - and you keep that promise.

events.speaker: okafor
lines: Sorry, kid. The price is 60 coins. Come back when you're ready.

lines.text: Next time, try to find out what he really cares about before you make your offer.

events.speaker: kofi
lines: Hey! I'm Kofi. I run my uncle's fruit stall.
Best apples in the whole market. Only 2 coins!

events.speaker: kofi
lines: Hey! You're selling things right next to my fruit stall now?
People who used to buy from me are buying from YOU!

events.speaker: kofi
lines: You again...

events.speaker: kofi
lines: Not today. I've got customers to win back.

events.speaker: kofi

effects.log: You and Kofi agreed to help each other's stalls.
effects.memory: Turned a rival into a friend: Kofi.

lines: Deal! I'll tell my customers where to get a cold drink.
And you won't sell apples anymore, right? Shake on it.

lines.text: From now on you won't sell apples, and Kofi sends thirsty customers your way. Working together, you both earn more.

events.speaker: kofi
lines: Whatever. I'll beat you on my own.

lines.text: Maybe try again tomorrow. What is Kofi really worried about?

events.speaker: grumble
lines: YOU! Yes, you! The lemonade I bought from your stall was WARM!
Warm lemonade! On a day like this! What kind of business are you running?

events.speaker: grumble
lines: Hmph. I'm still waiting.

events.speaker: grumble

effects.log: Mrs. Grumble calmed down and became a regular customer.
effects.memory: Turned an angry customer into a regular.

lines: ...Well. Maybe I was a little grumpy. My feet DO hurt.
You're a good kid. I'll be back tomorrow - and I'm bringing my friends.

events.speaker: grumble

effects.log: Mrs. Grumble stormed off and complained to everyone.

lines: I'm telling EVERYONE about this!

lines.text: Mrs. Grumble stomps away. Word spreads fast at the market.

events.speaker: maya
lines: The festival is only a couple of days away! We still don't have a stall... Mr. Okafor is at the market.

events.speaker: maya
lines: The festival is almost here! Lots of people means we'll need LOTS of stock.
It's Festival Day! Music drifts from the market square, and the whole town is heading there.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Today the park will be empty - everyone will be at the market!

events.speaker: dad
lines: A real market stall? My kids rented a STALL?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Just remember the 5 coin fee every day. A cost you pay even on a slow day is called a fixed cost.

events.speaker: maya
lines: Kofi gave me a free banana because we're partners now!

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: A good neighbour is worth more than a good price.

lines: The festival lights glow over the market square as you pack up your stall.

lines.speaker: dad
lines.text: You saved this family's summer. Look at the shop's account book!

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: I sold snacks from that old cart for thirty years. I never had a stall at the festival.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: I'm proud of you.

lines: The festival is over. You can still hear the music from the market square as you walk home.

lines.speaker: dad
lines.text: We didn't get to sell at the festival this year. That's okay.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Every business has a year like this. What matters is what you learned.
